verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the core flow: create a database instance with an indexing schema (orama-docs-15, orama-docs-37), insert documents in a way described as "quick and intuitive" with insertMultiple for bulk loads (orama-docs-2, orama-docs-24), and run full-text search (orama-gh-2). The GitHub README also shows simple setup paths via browser module import or Deno (orama-gh-6). Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end quickstart showing the search call, evidence backing the "within minutes" time-to-first-search claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
